title: Time bound for the threaded-map controller
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $f$ map Boolean words to Boolean words, and let $T$ be a time bound. If $M$ computes $f(x)$ within $T(|x|)$ steps for every Boolean word $x$, then the threaded-map controller built over $M$ computes, on every input $x$, the word obtained by pairing the first component $a$ of the decoded pair with $f(x)$ when decoding succeeds, and the empty word when decoding fails, within $4(T(|x|)+|x|+3)$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ computes the total function $f$ within time $T$
replaced:
Let $M$ compute the total function $f$ within time $T$. Then the threaded-map
controller built over $M$ computes, within $4(T(n) + n + 3)$ steps on inputs
of length $n$, the function sending a word $x$ that decodes under the
self-delimiting pair code with first component $a$ to the pair encoding of
$(a, f(x))$, and any malformed word to the empty word.
